title: Malden Café and Restaurant
summary: A premium Café and Restaurant bringing a refined taste to the local market, introducing an exceptional range of classic Italian and American delicacies to the iconic city of Addis Ababa, Bole.
overview_heading: A new taste to a local market
overview: Founded by a former Italian resident, Malden is rooted in cross-cultural integration and a deep passion for the culinary arts. The brand name itself is composed of family initials, reflecting a core value deeply shared by both Italian and Ethiopian cultures. Moving beyond its original suburban roots, Malden embarked on a comprehensive branding and interior modification process to establish a sophisticated, landmark destination designed specifically for the diaspora and international community.

deliverables.desc: A cross-cultural visual system crafted to tell the brand's story of origin and destination. Features a custom logo, thoughtful typography, and a premium color palette designed to stand out in the local market while remaining approachably familiar.
deliverables.title: Brand Identity

deliverables.desc: High-impact exterior and interior wayfinding elements engineered for the landmark Bole location. Designed to seamlessly guide guests through the space while establishing a bold, sophisticated street presence that captures the international community's attention.
deliverables.title: Signage Design

deliverables.desc: Structured layout frameworks for the print menus and collateral materials. Balancing classic Italian refinement with modern functionality, the typography and spacing are optimized to turn the culinary selection into a premium, easily readable visual experience.
deliverables.title: Layout
